name: Thierry Dubois
bio:
Thierry's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the meticulous detail of classic car restoration. Growing up in a small village near Spa-Francorchamps, he was surrounded by racing history, fueling his passion. He started as an apprentice in a local body shop, quickly mastering the art of paint application and color matching. 

Thierry is meticulous about surface preparation, believing a flawless finish starts long before the first coat of paint. He's eager to learn new techniques and adapt to the demands of modern racing liveries. He prides himself on his ability to deliver consistent, high-quality results, even under tight deadlines. Thierry is known for his patience and steady hand, essential qualities in the demanding world of motorsport paintwork.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Thierry is of average height, with a focused gaze and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always wears blue latex gloves, even when not actively painting.
Has a small collection of vintage car model kits on his workbench.
Whistles softly while working, usually classical music.
